# Guest Post Platform — Full Website Context

> Guest Post Platform is a guest posting and blogger outreach service founded by Kamran. It supports SEO agencies, online brands, consultants, and website owners with relevant editorial placement campaigns.

Canonical website: https://guestpostplatform.com/

Founder: Kamran

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kamranofficialseo/

WhatsApp and telephone: +923025820230

Service area: Worldwide

## Services

- [Guest Posting](https://guestpostplatform.com/services.html): Individual guest post placements selected using topical relevance, available traffic information, authority indicators, editorial context, and budget.
- [Blogger Outreach](https://guestpostplatform.com/services.html): Managed publisher research, communication, topic planning, content coordination, publication follow-up, and live-link reporting.
- [Link Insertion](https://guestpostplatform.com/services.html#link-insertion): Contextual citations added to suitable existing editorial content.
- [Content Writing](https://guestpostplatform.com/services.html): Original content prepared for the target publication and its audience.
- [White-Label Campaigns](https://guestpostplatform.com/services.html): Agency-friendly fulfillment and reporting.

## Pricing

- [Starter — DA 20–40](https://guestpostplatform.com/pricing.html): Listed from USD 45 per post.
- [Popular — DA 40–60](https://guestpostplatform.com/pricing.html): Listed from USD 95 per post.
- [Premium — DA 60+](https://guestpostplatform.com/pricing.html): Listed from USD 180 per post.
- Custom monthly and recurring campaigns are quoted separately.

Prices, publisher availability, traffic estimates, and third-party authority metrics may change. Confirm current campaign details before purchase.

## Outreach Process

1. The client shares a website, target page, niche, preferred market, and budget.
2. Relevant publisher opportunities and available quality information are reviewed.
3. Content and publication requirements are coordinated.
4. The client receives the published URL and confirmed placement details.

## Quality and Claims

- Publisher relevance and editorial context are considered alongside third-party authority metrics.
- Domain Authority is not a Google metric and is not treated as a ranking guarantee.
- Guest Post Platform does not guarantee rankings, traffic increases, or indexing outcomes.
- Confirmed placement facts are separated from changing third-party metrics.
